shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure with head at top
circular disc/rosette motif on the chest or torso
horizontal band or belt across the waist
elongated tapering objects flanking the body (weapon-like forms)
incised/outlined linear detailing on the body

justification: Both present a strictly frontal, vertically stacked anthropomorphic scheme — head on top, a prominent circular disc on the chest, a horizontal belt-like band at the waist, and narrow tapering weapon-like forms hanging at the sides — which is the most specific correspondence. The biggest difference is the medium and manner: A is a flat, brightly coloured, sharply outlined graphic with fully articulated limbs, gripping hands and facial features, while B is an eroded, monochrome stone monolith whose motifs are shallow, schematic relief with no separated limbs or narrative action.
